findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 20 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 66 questions numbered 1-66; by section: 20.1 6, 20.1.1 6, 20.1.2 7, 20.2 7, 20.3 4, 20.3.1 15, 20.4 8, 20.4.1 2, 20.4.2 5, 20.4.3 6.

Covers sections 20.1-20.4.3 in order; comparison questions are answered as two-column tables; small numericals (resonance energy with new values, Å to pm, combustion and hydrogenation moles) were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise (its chlorination mechanism, acylium ion from ethanoyl chloride, delocalised π-bond definition, naming items and phenol bromination are avoided). Book corrections followed: resonance energy 152 kJ mol⁻¹, sp²–s C–H bond, 1,4 = para, [AlBr₄]⁻ in bromination, cyclohexene adds Br₂ readily, balanced methylbenzene chlorination, KMnO₄ test limits.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
